label: The second-highest level
subgoals: List the decision level of each literal of the learned clause
Take the highest remaining level, or 0 if none remains

label: From trail to backjump level
subgoals: Compute the first-UIP clause from the trail
Read the decision level of every literal in it
Backjump to the second-highest level and propagate the asserted literal

label: How much search is skipped
subgoals: Note the conflict level and the backjump level
Compute the chronological target as the conflict level minus one
Subtract the backjump level to get the levels skipped
